bio: This pleasant restaurant is situated within the traffic-restricted area of Sarzana, just a few steps from the beautiful central piazza of this small town (which is in Liguria, although the dialect spoken here has a Tuscan influence). With a new name and a new team at the helm, the restaurant serves delicious, colourful cuisine that follows the seasons, with a balance of reasonably priced meat and fish dishes on the menu. A spacious outdoor summer-dining space shaded by parasols, plus courteous, efficient female staff complete the picture....
